description: Littoral aquitain : position du trait de côte par télédétection spatiale en 2010 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geotransfert.epoc.u-bordeaux1.fr. This map represents the location of the foot of the dune at different sites on the Aquitaine coast by analysis of Formosat-2 images from 2010. Work carried out as part of the INFOLITTORAL-1 programme by GEO-Transfer and based on images provided by ASTRIUM GEOINFORMATION SERVICES. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Aquitaine coast: position of the rib line by spatial remote sensing in 2010" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trait de côte, risques, 2010, inspire, dune, epoc. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
